title: What Are the Filipino Wedding Traditions You Did Not Know?
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget

refresh_of.note: Person: older, already-ranking article to use as reference. Recommend 301 to the new URL at publish.

notes: REFRESH: the brief reads the old page in full with mcp__Apify__apify--web-fetch; SEO pulls its ranked keywords and status and checks whether any other of our pages ranks for the keyword. Keep its traditions if sourceable; never reuse wording; re-source claims; correct brand terms (old pages have used wrong ones).

Likely customs (brief finalises): pamamanhikan (formal visit to the bride's family), despedida de soltera, principal and secondary sponsors (ninong and ninang), the arras (13 coins), the veil and the cord (yugal), the candle sponsors, rice or petal shower, release of doves, money dance, barong tagalog and terno or Filipiniana, wedding feast; plus customs from Muslim Filipino communities only where sourced. Do not present every custom as Catholic; note regional or faith variation only where sourced.

Destination angle: marrying in the Philippines as Australians. Check Smartraveller's current Philippines advice live (overall level and any regions at higher levels) and only suggest areas outside higher-level regions. Legal steps from official sources only (Smartraveller, Australian Embassy Manila, Philippine government); 'a fee applies'; otherwise 'check with the local civil registrar'.

Sources: national museums or cultural agencies (e.g. National Commission for Culture and the Arts, National Museum of the Philippines), Catholic Bishops' or archdiocesan pages for church rites, encyclopaedias, academic sources. Unsourced becomes 'often told' or is left out.
Images: placeholders only; no AI images of people, cultural dress, ceremonies or places; AI only for neutral still lifes (e.g. 13 coins, a cord and veil) labelled illustrative pending approval.

Speed: WebFetch cannot reach outside sites; Apify web-fetch (parallel) and DataForSEO from the start. Fact-check as 2 parallel batches, 15 min hard; no extra sourcing rounds. Batches use separate scratch folders. Google Drive disconnected; Firecrawl out of credits.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices; no vendor names; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
